Options:
  -p, --port PORT  Select serial port
  -b, --baud BAUD  Set baud rate
  --parity PARITY  Set parity
  --rtscts  Enable hardware flow control
  --xonxoff  Enable software flow control
  --rts LEVEL  Set RTS signal
  --dtr LEVEL  Set DTR signal
  --echo  Echo input locally
  -f, --filter FILTER  Select a stream filter
  --encoding ENCODING  Set stream encoding
  -e, --environment ENVIRONMENT  Select project environment
  -d, --project-dir DIRECTORY  Select project directory
